search_text: published ZDI-26-521 ZDI-CAN-27762 Phoenix Contact CHARX SEC-3000 Command Injection Remote Code Execution Vulnerability 2026-07-30 CVE-2026-44095 https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2026-44095 6.8 AV:A/AC:L/PR:H/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H ['Phoenix Contact'] ['CHARX SEC-3000'] This vulnerability allows network-adjacent attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of Phoenix Contact CHARX SEC-3000 devices. title: Phoenix Contact CHARX SEC-3000 Command Injection Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows network-adjacent attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of Phoenix Contact CHARX SEC-3000 devices. Authentication is required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the handling of the defaultroutemetric parameter to the config service. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of a user-supplied string before using it to execute a system call. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of root.
